data.title: 'Bangkok Raw'  shows unseen city
data.description: Bangkok's hidden side is presented through photography during "Bangkok Raw", which is running at Old Town Gallery, until Oct 31.

data.title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026  gathers 72 global creatives  across 11 city venues
data.description: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 is set to run from Oct 29 to Feb 28 under the theme "Angels & Mara" across temples, museums, cultural institutions and public spaces alongside a wider city programme of independent exhibitions.

data.title: Force majeure,  human minutiae  collide at RCB's  'Worldbuilding'
data.description: The relationship between the macro world and the micro scale of everyday life is reflected through "Worldbuilding: Macro/Micro Exhibition" which is running at RCB Galleria 3, River City Bangkok, Charoen Krung 24, until Nov 1.

data.title: Pushing the limits
data.description: Strapping his feet to a rowing machine, Vasupol Leerungruang pulled the handles to his chest, leaned forward on the return and repeated the rhythm. In front of him was a monitor that tracked and compared his progress with others. This was part of his training to ensure he is in the best shape possible to compete in next year's Hyrox World Championships in Hong Kong.

data.title: Tour of Thailand put off to dodge northern smog
data.description: Thailand's flagship international cycling race has been postponed by three months to avoid the hazardous smog that blankets the north each spring.

data.title: War Elephants drawn to face Brunei in King's Cup opener
data.description: Sri Sa Ket is ready to host the King's Cup for the first time in the tournament's history when the 52nd edition kicks off next month, organisers confirmed at a press conference on Monday.

data.title: Nithikorn strikes first gold for Kingdom
data.description: Nithikorn Jeampiriyakul helped Thailand open their account at the 2026 Asian Para Games in Japan, winning the country's first gold in the men's 200m freestyle S14 on Monday.

data.title: New pilot zone to curb bribery
data.description: The government will use Bangkok's Khao San Road as a pilot zone to tackle bribery involving entertainment venues and speed up action against corrupt officials.

data.title: Group calls for halt to social security advisers' selection
data.description: The Progressive Social Security group has called for a halt to the selection of advisers to the Social Security Board, saying the selection committee must be named by the newly elected board.

data.title: House re-invites MP Suchada to explain gambling claims
data.description: A House committee will again invite Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to explain alleged links to online gambling and a reported bribery offer at its meeting on Thursday, chairman Rangsiman Rome said on Monday.

data.title: Deadlock over debate time persists
data.description: The government and opposition remain at odds over the duration of the upcoming no-confidence debate, with the government proposing three days and the opposition holding firm on its demand for five.

data.title: Orange Line trials to start late next year
data.description: The eastern section of the Orange Line MRT is slated to open for trial runs starting from December next year, with fare collection set to begin in January the following year.

data.title: New Cold War tests Thai choices
data.description: A new Cold War is emerging as the United States and China compete from trade and finance to outer space, scholars and senior journalists have warned, urging Thailand not to pick sides too soon.

data.title: Israel announces arrests after West Bank settler attacks on Westerners
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli police said Monday they had arrested 10 people in the occupied West Bank after settler attacks on an American photographer and a French mayor that drew international condemnation but mixed messages from the government.

data.title: Ukraine on back foot as Kremlin moots US, China meeting
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Ukraine on Monday again said it had no early warning of powerful Russian missile strikes and complained that persistent problems with a US military grade satellite were hobbling frontline troops.

data.title: Kenyan cult leader guilty on all charges over 191 starvation deaths
data.description: MOMBASA (KENYA) - A self-proclaimed Kenyan preacher and his associates were on Monday found guilty of murdering 191 people, mostly children, in an infamous starvation cult.

data.title: Minister orders checks over pollution complaints
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa on Monday ordered further factory inspections and water sampling in Prachin Buri after residents complained of pollution, pledging that any action would comply with the law.

data.title: Digital wallets lead to Cambodia scam
data.description: Police traced cryptocurrency transactions across dozens of anonymous digital wallets to identify a money-laundering network linked to scam operations in Cambodia, leading to 39 arrests and the seizure of assets worth more than 500 million baht.

data.title: NSC steps up southern safeguards
data.description: The National Security Council (NSC) is stepping up preventive measures in the southern border provinces alongside peace talks, seeking to prevent further incidents and rebuild public trust.

data.title: BMA apologises for flood relief delays
data.description: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt has apologised to flood-hit residents after applications for financial assistance surged beyond expectations, with more than 1 million claims registered.

data.title: Govt 'committed' to protecting territory
data.description: Thailand has reaffirmed its commitment to protecting its sovereignty in maritime boundary talks with Cambodia, as the two countries consider measures to ease tensions and keep negotiations on track.

data.title: New travel  subsidies for tour groups
data.description: The government is offering transport subsidies of up to 40,000 baht per trip to encourage domestic group travel and generate at least 208.8 million baht in tourism revenue.

data.title: Ethiopia PM warns Eritrea of 'severe consequences' if supports enemies
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Ethiopia's Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed warned Eritrea on Monday that it faces "severe consequences" if it continues to support rebels in his country.

data.title: Netanyahu basks in Trump endorsement week before election
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday basked in Donald Trump's endorsement days before close-fought elections, airing a call in which the US president predicted he would win and suggested they may again attack Iran together.

data.title: Japan launches rocket for potential world first Mars moon mission
data.description: TOKYO - Japanese scientists launched a spacecraft Tuesday that aims to be the first to retrieve samples from one of Mars's moons, potentially helping unlock the origins of the Solar System and life on Earth.

data.title: UN climate panel head wants swift end to deadlock over key scientific report
data.description: GENEVA (SWITZERLAND) - The world's top climate scientists will reconvene at the earliest opportunity, the panel's chair said on Monday, after member states failed to agree when to release its crucial new findings on global heating.

data.title: Putin, Xi and Trump could meet at APEC summit: Kremlin
data.description: MOSCOW - The Russian, Chinese and US presidents, Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump, could potentially meet at an upcoming Asia-Pacific summit in China, the Kremlin said on Monday.

data.title: Albanian PM warns of 'red line' after days of unrest
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama accused protesters of crossing a "red line" Monday after a police station was set ablaze during anti-government demonstrations.

data.title: CEA Drives Thailand’s IP Finance Ecosystem Towards Global Growth
data.description: The Creative Economy Agency (Public Organization), or CEA, hosted “CREATIVITY AS CAPITAL: Driving the Next Growth Frontier”as an Official Affiliated Programme of the 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings. The programme featured a forum titled “Building the Enabling Environment: Policy Platforms and Intensives for a Competitive Creative Sector ,” sharing perspectives for creating friendly ecosystem that facilitates Thailand’s creative industry. It has included other essential instruments such as financial system development, IP for asset, foreign investment promotion, paving a way for local content creators to connect with the global markets.

data.title: Zoo turns viral hippo feeding fail into visitor attraction
data.description: A Thai zoo has responded to a viral video showing a woman repeatedly trying and failing to feed a hippopotamus by introducing a hippo statue that allows visitors to practice their aim, turning an internet sensation into an interactive attraction.

data.title: Lampang school hit by second fire in three days
data.description: LAMPANG — About 40 students fled a classroom at Bunyawat Witthayalai School on Monday after an air conditioner caught fire, the second blaze at the school in three days. No injuries were reported.

data.title: Indonesia fires have burned nearly two million hectares: monitor
data.description: JAKARTA (INDONESIA) - Fires in Indonesia that have caused a regional haze crisis burned through over 1.9 million hectares between January and the end of September this year, a monitor analysing satellite imagery said on Monday.
